A stepper step

Source: R/stepper.R
shad_step.Rd

A stepper step

Usage

shad_step(title, description = NULL, content = NULL, error = FALSE)

Arguments

title

Step label.

description

Optional secondary line.

content

Optional panel content shown when the step is active.

error

If TRUE, seed the step in an error state.

Value

A shad_step object consumed by shad_stepper().

See also

Other shadshiny flow: shad_dropzone(), shad_number_input(), shad_rating(), shad_stepper(), shad_tree(), shad_tree_item(), update_shad_number_input(), update_shad_rating(), update_shad_stepper(), update_shad_tree()

Examples

shad_stepper(
  "checkout",
  shad_step("Cart"),
  shad_step("Payment", description = "Card declined", error = TRUE),
  shad_step("Review"),
  active = 2
)
